Yemen Condemns Terrorist Attack Targeting Syrian Internal Security Forces Headquarters in Hasakah
articles.description: ADEN – SABA The Republic of Yemen has strongly condemned and denounced the terrorist attack that targeted a headquarters of the Internal Security Forces in the city of Hasakah, in the sisterly Syrian Arab Republic, resulting in several deaths and injuries. In a statement issued Thursday, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates reaffirmed the Republic of Yemen’s solidarity with the Syrian Arab Republic in confronting terrorism and extremism in all their forms. It also expressed Yemen’s support for the Syrian government’s efforts to enhance security and stability, and to safeguard the country’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. The Ministry extended its sincere condolences and deepest sympathies to the Syrian government and people, as well as to the families of the victims, and wished those injured a speedy recovery.

Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack on Syrian Security Forces Site in Al-Hasakah
articles.description: The Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's strongest condemnation and denunciation of the terrorist attack that targeted a Syrian security forces site in Al-Hasakah Governorate in the brotherly Syrian Arab Republic, SPA reported. The Kingdom stressed its complete rejection of all forms of violence, terrorism, and extremism, affirming its solidarity with Syria, the government and people, in preserving its security and safety.
